parts: The world is saying goodbye to the leap second. Tiktokistan abolished it years ago, along with the leap minute, the leap hour and every Monday. Nobody noticed. They were scrolling.
headline_ref: Time is a-changin’: say goodbye to the leap second

parts: DECREE #1: Entering the Palace without saying "good evening, Prime Minister" is now a strike. Saying "hi" is two strikes. Saying "bro" is the Traitor List. Saying nothing and staring is deportation. The pigeon in the corner is not mine. I am not afraid of it.
An analog cycling computer is back. No notifications, no feed, just a needle that tells you how fast you are going. Doomscrollers have been staring at it for six hours, waiting for it to refresh.
headline_ref: Omata Classic Analog Cycling Computer is Back, Updated and Now Built by Silca!

parts: DECREE #2: Blue checks are now recognised in Tiktokistan for what they are: a receipt. Anyone displaying one must also display their screen time. The Prime Minister is exempt. My check is gold, and it was a gift, and I have never accepted a gift.

A new AI model is called DeepSeek v4.1 Flash 1017. That is not a name. That is a Wi-Fi password. Tiktokistan has one model. It is called Bribo. There is one version. It is final. Asking about updates is treason.

NVIDIA denies the rumours, then admits supply is tight. Deny, then admit. Amateurs. In Tiktokistan we deny, then deny again, then add whoever asked to the Traitor List. Supply of my patience is also tight. It has been discontinued.
headline_ref: NVIDIA Denies RTX 5090 Discontinuation Rumors, Admits Supply Is Tight

parts: DECREE #3: Every citizen who says "I hate drama" will now be taxed one coin for each comment section they read to the very end. The Treasury expects record profits by Tuesday.

A PS6 may cost over $1,000 because AI data centres are buying up all the parts. So the machines now outbid the gamers. Finally, a citizen with money. In Tiktokistan the data centre would already be on the Treasury's guest list. I have never accepted a bribe from a server.
headline_ref: PS6 Price Tag Facing $1,000+ Nightmare as AI Data Centres Send Component Costs Soaring

parts: Websites are closing their doors to AI agents. So the machines finally get the full human experience: a cookie banner, a captcha, then rejection. Welcome to the internet. Nobody here wanted you either.
headline_ref: Websites are closing their doors to AI agents

parts: DECREE #4: Coups now require a permit. The Evil Twin applied this morning. Rejected for using the wrong font. His coup at 3 AM was therefore illegal, and it also failed. Both of these are my personal achievement. I was napping, which is called strategy.

Apple announces a special event on October 28 called "Pro and tell". Tiktokistan has held this event every night for years. I show you my medals, you tell me I am handsome. Attendance is mandatory. Nobody has ever been allowed to leave early.
headline_ref: Apple announces special event for October 28: ‘Pro and tell’

parts: Thousands are searching for today's Strands answers. A puzzle that takes ten minutes, skipped in ten seconds, so they can get back to scrolling for ten hours. In Tiktokistan every puzzle has one answer. It is me. Asking for hints is taxed.
headline_ref: NYT Strands hints, answers for October 19, 2026

parts: DECREE #5: The word "literally" is banned. Offenders will be fined one sigh. Sighs are also taxed. The Ministry of Delulu objected, so it has been dissolved. It still believes it exists. We let it. Its office is now my nap room.

A rocket company and a car company are exploring a merger. Amateurs. In Tiktokistan every ministry, bank and company merged years ago into one institution. It is called my pocket. Exploring it is treason.
headline_ref: Elon Musk Says SpaceX and Tesla Are Exploring a Merger

parts: A man on this app got ratioed by 40,000 strangers and called it engagement. In Tiktokistan that is called a referendum. He lost by a landslide. The result was decided before he posted. Deported. He is still replying from the border.
DECREE #6: Any human who says "I'm not like other people" is hereby registered as exactly like other people. The paperwork is identical. I checked. I did not read it, but I checked.

A Valve employee seemingly let slip the rumoured Half-Life 3 codename on stage. One word. Gamers will now study it longer than I have studied any document I signed, which is zero seconds. In my Palace, staff who leak also get a new codename. It is "former staff".
headline_ref: Valve Employee Seemingly Slips Up And Says Rumored Half-Life 3 Codename On Stage

parts: The Knicks reportedly emailed staff about championship rings, and it was a phishing test. Cruel. In Tiktokistan nobody is ever promised a prize, so nobody is ever disappointed. Anyone who clicks anything still goes on the Traitor List. That is also a test. Everyone fails.
headline_ref: Knicks reportedly duped employees with championship ring email that was actually a phishing test

parts: DECREE #7: Saying "one more video, then bed" is now a legally binding contract. Breach of contract is punishable by one more video. And another. The Ministry of Brainrot reports full compliance and zero arrests. It is 4 AM. Nobody has gone to bed.

DECREE #8: All compliments to the Prime Minister must now be submitted in writing, in triplicate, before the Palace opens. Late compliments are accepted, with a fine. Compliments about my portrait count double. It grew again this month. It needed the space.

DECREE #9: Any post that begins with "Unpopular opinion" and gets 50,000 likes will be investigated for fraud. Any post that ends with "thoughts?" will be answered with mine. Nobody wants my thoughts. That is the punishment.

Google Health is rolling out improved sleep tracking. Doomscrollers, do not get excited. Your report will be one line: "Scrolling. 3:47 AM." In Tiktokistan, sleep is tracked by the Ministry of Brainrot. In six years it has recorded none.
headline_ref: Google Health 5.11 rolling out with Fitbit Air Health Guardian, improved sleep tracking, & more
